goodnews.h: LA's fall showstopper: the Chinese flame tree
goodnews.b: Chinese flame trees are brightening Los Angeles with yellow fall blooms that give way to pink or reddish capsules reminiscent of paper lanterns.
goodnews.title: Move over, jacaranda. LA’s fall showstopper is the Chinese flame tree

local.h: NYC team to help residents keep SNAP, Medicaid
local.b: Mayor Mamdani launched a Health and Affordability Resource Team of outreach workers to help New Yorkers keep benefits as federal eligibility rules change.
local.title: Mamdani launches new team to help NYers keep SNAP, Medicaid benefits

local.h: Ex-buildings chief Eric Ulrich goes on trial
local.b: Eric Ulrich, Eric Adams' former buildings commissioner, heads to trial three years after his arrest on charges of taking more than $150,000 in bribes.
local.title: Eric Adams' NYC buildings boss Eric Ulrich heads to trial, 3 years after arrest

local.h: NYC sues law firm over bogus trip-and-fall claims
local.b: The city's law department is going after Lower Manhattan firm Asher & Associates over lawsuits it says were fraudulent, including a $1 million sidewalk claim.
local.title: NYC sues personal injury law firm accused of bogus trip-and-fall claims

local.b: After two deadly Legionnaires' outbreaks this summer on the Upper East Side and in the Bronx, a City Council bill would require building owners to report lower levels of Legionella in cooling towers.
local.title: NYC Council to consider earlier Legionella reporting after deadly outbreaks

local.b: A four-alarm fire scorched a commercial building on Hylan Boulevard, injuring two people including a firefighter, but the nearby Old Church of St. Joachim and St. Anne was not damaged, the FDNY said.
local.title: Staten Island fire injures 2, but spares historic 'Godfather' church

local.h: Bail reform still central in NY governor's race
local.b: Seven years after it became law, bail reform remains a major issue in the governor's race, with opponents pointing to cases like a Rochester man who fired at an officer while out on bail.
local.title: Bail reform remains major issue in NY governor's race, 7 years after it became law

goodnews.h: Free 2-K expands to the Bronx and Staten Island
goodnews.b: Every school district in the Bronx and Staten Island will offer free preschool seats for 2-year-olds next fall, as the city adds 10,000 seats.
goodnews.title: These are the NYC neighborhoods that will get free 2-K next fall

goodnews.h: New NYC site helps find mental health care
goodnews.b: NYC Mental Health Connect lists more than 600 behavioral health providers across the five boroughs, searchable by service, symptoms, age, location and insurance.
goodnews.title: Need help with mental health or addiction services? NYC has a new tool.

local.h: Storm and flood warnings for southern France
local.b: Météo-France put Hérault, Gard, Var, Lozère and Bouches-du-Rhône on orange alert for violent Mediterranean storms, with up to 200mm of rain possible.
local.title: Storm and flood warnings for south of France

local.h: Protesters block the Louvre amid unrest
local.b: Protesters blocked the Louvre entrance on Monday after weekend cost-of-living demonstrations turned violent. Macron ordered a security review.
In a TV address, Macron said nothing 'explains, excuses or justifies' the violence and looting, but promised meetings to address the cost-of-living worries of those who protested peacefully.
Saturday's protests brought clashes, street blazes and widespread looting, with masked crowds stripping stores. Prosecutors said more than 500 people were held in custody.

local.h: Limoges town hall 'largely lost' to protest fire
local.b: Masked protesters set fire to the 143-year-old building, whose roof collapsed onto lower floors, the regional prefect said, calling it 'a catastrophe for heritage.' The fire is now contained.

local.h: A year after heist, Louvre faces uncertain future
local.b: The Louvre is closing security gaps exposed by last year's theft of eight crown jewels, but its reputation has suffered and its aging infrastructure is a growing concern.
